When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.

This 2019 Mazda Mazda3 Preferred sedan delivers reliable performance and practical comfort for drivers who value quality and efficiency.

- Machine Gray Metallic Paint
- Heated Front Bucket Seats
- Leatherette Seat Trim
- 12 Speakers with SiriusXM
- AppLink/Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Automatic Temperature Control with Front Dual Zone A/C
- Exterior Parking Camera Rear

- Aluminum Speaker Grille
- Exterior Mirrors with Memory Positioning
- 18" Alloy Wheels
- Telescoping and Tilt Steering Wheel

The Mazda3 Preferred combines everyday practicality with thoughtful design. Its four-cylinder engine paired with a six-speed automatic transmission achieves 26 MPG in the city and 35 MPG on the highway, making it an efficient choice for commuting and longer drives alike. The gray metallic exterior presents a professional appearance that complements both business and personal settings.

Inside, you'll find comfort features designed for daily driving. Heated front bucket seats with leatherette trim provide warmth during colder months and a touch of refinement. The front dual zone automatic temperature control lets both driver and passenger set their preferred comfort levels independently. Memory seat positioning saves your preferred settings for easier entry each time you drive.

Technology integration keeps you connected seamlessly. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility means your smartphone integrates naturally with the audio system. The 12-speaker SiriusXM-equipped sound system delivers quality audio whether you're enjoying music, podcasts, or satellite radio. Steering wheel-mounted controls let you manage these functions without taking your hands off the wheel.

Safety and visibility receive appropriate attention throughout the design. The rearview camera assists with parking and reversing, while auto high-beam headlights adapt to driving conditions automatically. Electronic stability control, traction control, and a comprehensive airbag system including front, side, and knee airbags work together to support your protection. Rain-sensing wipers adjust automatically to moisture levels, and the low tire pressure warning system helps you maintain proper inflation.

This Mazda3 Preferred stands ready to serve as your reliable daily transportation, offering the balance of efficiency, comfort, and capability that makes it a practical choice for any driver.

- Audi MMI Navigation Plus w/MMI Touch and 8.3" center screen

Audi Side Assist monitors your blind spots, while the electronic stability control and four-wheel independent suspension provide a secure foundation for confident driving.

The 16-inch 10-spoke alloy wheels sit on a platform built for driver engagement, with speed-sensing steering that adjusts to your driving style and four-wheel independent suspension that absorbs road imperfections. The tilt and telescoping steering wheel ensures every driver finds their ideal position, enhancing control and reducing fatigue on longer drives.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Predictive brake assist - Be prepared for your big brake. Predictive brake assist monitors the available distance in front of you compared to your vehicles speed. If your speed exceeds the required distance to stop short of a collision, it readies your brakes to apply maximum stopping force when you use them. Predictive brake assist helps see to it that you stop.

Available at T & D Auto Group in Fresno, in the heart of Fresno County, this 2023 Prius LE represents one of the most fuel-efficient and technologically advanced vehicles Toyota has ever produced — and at a used price point, it offers exceptional value for the right buyer.

The fifth-generation Prius completely rewrote the script for hybrid cars. Where earlier Priuses were praised for efficiency but often criticized for bland styling and uninspiring drives, the 2023 model arrived with bold, aerodynamic lines, a dramatically upgraded interior, and a completely rethought hybrid powertrain. This is a Prius that people actually want to drive.About This 2023 Toyota Prius LE Hatchback This particular 2023 Prius LE carries 108,225 miles, which is a significant number — but important context is everything here. Toyota hybrids, and the Prius in particular, are famously engineered to last well beyond 200,000 miles with proper maintenance. The hybrid battery system on fifth-generation Prius models is covered under Toyota's 10-year/150,000-mile hybrid component warranty (for the original owner), and the drivetrain's regenerative braking system actually reduces wear on conventional brake components, meaning high-mileage Prius vehicles often have healthier brake systems than comparable gas-only cars at similar mileage.

For a commuter vehicle in the Central Valley where Fresno drivers log serious daily miles on CA-99, CA-41, or across Fresno County's wide suburban spread, the Prius LE makes an exceptionally practical daily driver. This is a vehicle built for exactly the kind of use those miles represent.2023 Toyota Prius Performance and Engine Under the hood, this 2023 Prius LE is powered by Toyota's all-new 2.0-liter 4-cylinder hybrid engine — a significant upgrade over the previous generation's 1.8-liter system. Combined with the ECVT automatic transmission and front-wheel drive, the new powertrain produces a combined 194 horsepower, which is a remarkable leap for the Prius nameplate and puts to rest the old reputation of hybrid sluggishness.

Real-World Fuel Economy

The 2023 Prius LE is EPA-rated at approximately 57 MPG city and 56 MPG highway, with a combined estimate around 57 MPG. For Fresno drivers dealing with stop-and-go traffic along Blackstone Avenue, Shaw Avenue, or the daily commute corridors throughout Fresno County, that fuel efficiency translates directly into serious savings at the pump. At today's California gas prices, a Prius owner can expect to spend dramatically less on fuel compared to a comparable non-hybrid sedan or crossover.

Transmission and Drive Feel

The ECVT (Electronically Controlled Variable Transmission) on the 2023 Prius is smoother and more responsive than ever before. Unlike traditional CVTs, Toyota's hybrid ECVT uses a planetary gear set that works seamlessly with the dual electric motors, delivering power in a linear, refined way that feels natural rather than mechanical. Around town or on a freeway run out to Clovis or the surrounding Fresno County communities, this drivetrain feels composed and confident.Toyota Prius LE Features and Interior The LE trim is Toyota's entry point into the fifth-generation Prius lineup, but don't mistake entry level for bare bones. The 2023 Prius LE arrives with a genuinely well-equipped cabin that sets a new standard for what a base hybrid can offer.

Standard features on the 2023 Prius LE include an 8-inch touchscreen infotainment display running Toyota's latest multimedia system, wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration, a pre-collision warning system with automatic emergency braking, lane departure alert with lane-keeping assist, and automatic high beams as part of Toyota Safety Sense 3.0. As a 4-door hatchback, the 2023 Prius LE offers practical rear cargo access with a versatile hatch opening and a usable rear seat for adult passengers. Visibility improvements from Toyota's rethought roof profile make this generation significantly easier to drive in traffic and tight parking situations — something Fresno shoppers navigating busy retail corridors or urban neighborhoods will appreciate.Toyota Prius Reliability and Ownership The Prius is one of the most proven vehicles in automotive history when it comes to long-term reliability. Consumer Reports consistently ranks the Prius among the most reliable vehicles in any segment, and real-world data from rideshare drivers and fleet operators confirms that these cars routinely exceed 250,000 to 300,000 miles without major powertrain failures.

The fifth-generation platform introduced in 2023 builds on all of that proven reliability while adding modern safety tech and improved performance. The hybrid battery system uses lithium-ion technology (an upgrade from the nickel-metal hydride batteries in earlier generations), which is more energy-dense and responsive. High-mileage buyers should note that Toyota's hybrid batteries are designed with longevity in mind and are rarely a problem in properly maintained vehicles. Routine maintenance needs on the Prius are also lower than average — fewer oil changes due to the hybrid system's reduced engine load, and significantly reduced brake wear thanks to regenerative braking.Why Buy From T & D Auto Group in Fresno, CA T & D Auto Group is a locally operated used car dealer serving buyers throughout Fresno and the greater Fresno County area. Whether you're a first-time buyer, a rideshare driver looking for your next fuel-efficient workhorse, or a family driver who wants reliability without a new-car payment, T & D Auto Group in Fresno is worth a visit. Discover the refined practicality and modern capability of this 2023 Honda Civic EX-L, presented in a striking red exterior that commands attention on the road. This sedan delivers a balanced combination of efficiency and dependable performance, making it an ideal choice for drivers who value both daily usability and driving satisfaction.

- 180-Watt Audio System with 8 Speakers
- Apple CarPlay/Android Auto Integration
- Adaptive Cruise Control with Low-Speed Follow

This powertrain provides responsive handling while maintaining efficiency for your commute or weekend travels. Front-wheel drive traction and a responsive four-wheel independent suspension system ensure confident cornering and reliable road grip in various conditions.

Safety remains at the forefront of the Civic's engineering. Dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, and overhead airbags work alongside electronic stability control and traction control to protect you and your passengers. The brake assist system, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, lane keeping assist, and rear parking camera all contribute to confident, aware driving. Emergency communication through HondaLink provides additional peace of mind.

Inside, the cabin reflects thoughtful design and comfort. The heated front bucket seats feature leather-trimmed surfaces, while the heated front seats and split folding rear seat accommodate both comfort and versatility. Automatic dual-zone air conditioning maintains your preferred temperature, and the power moonroof adds an open-air experience. The leather steering wheel and shift knob underscore the refined touch throughout the interior.

Technology integration keeps you connected seamlessly. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility through the 180-watt audio system allows you to access navigation, music, and communication applications directly from your smartphone. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls enable hands-free operation, enhancing safety and convenience during your drive.

This 2023 Honda Civic EX-L represents genuine value for those seeking a well-equipped sedan with practical features, proven reliability, and modern conveniences all working together to enhance your driving experience.

This 2017 Volkswagen Golf GTI S delivers a compelling combination of performance-oriented engineering and practical everyday functionality that appeals to drivers who appreciate both capability and efficiency.

- Heated front seats for comfort in cold weather
- Rear backup camera for enhanced visibility and safety
- Power driver seat with adjustable controls
- 18" Austin Alloy wheels
- Radio: Composition Media w/6.5" Touchscreen
- 8 speakers with SiriusXM AM/FM radio
- Leather steering wheel and shift knob
- Front fog lights
- Electronic Stability Control
- Telescoping and tilt steering wheel
- Dual front impact airbags with anti-whiplash restraints
- Four-wheel independent suspension
- Sport steering wheel
- Heated door mirrors with power adjustment
- Remote keyless entry

The 2.0L TSI engine paired with a 6-speed manual transmission provides responsive performance while maintaining competitive fuel economy at 24 mpg city and 34 mpg highway. This front-wheel-drive configuration ensures reliable handling and traction across various driving conditions, making the GTI a practical choice for daily commuting and weekend enjoyment.

The interior reflects thoughtful design with cloth seating surfaces, front bucket seats, and a split-folding rear seat that adapts to your cargo needs. The Composition Media touchscreen display with an 8-speaker audio system keeps you connected and entertained, while cruise control and steering wheel-mounted audio controls minimize distractions during your drive.

Safety features include a comprehensive airbag system, electronic stability control, traction control, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, and brake assist technology. The rear backup camera provides visual confirmation when reversing, and the low tire pressure warning system helps maintain optimal vehicle performance and safety.

The GTI Rubber Mats Kit featuring Monster mats with the GTI logo and a heavy-duty trunk liner provides protection for your vehicle's interior. Security wheel locks with a coded key safeguard your wheels against theft, adding an extra layer of protection for your investment.

With its gray exterior, alloy wheels, and sporty styling cues including a body-color spoiler, this Golf GTI S presents a refined and purposeful appearance. The combination of performance heritage, efficient operation, and practical features positions this vehicle as a solid choice for buyers seeking a well-rounded driving experience.

This 2017 Audi A7 3.0T Prestige quattro combines sophisticated design with practical performance for the discerning driver.

- 3.0L V6 Turbocharged engine with 333 horsepower
- Audi MMI Navigation Plus with AM/FM and SiriusXM
- Head-Up Display projecting driving information into your line of sight
- Cold Weather Package with heated rear seats and heated steering wheel
- S Line Sport Package with sport suspension and distinctive exterior styling
- Prestige Package including power close doors and front seat ventilation
- 20" bi-color wheels with all-season tires
- Bose sound system with subwoofer and 14 speakers
- Leather seating surfaces with heated front seats and passenger lumbar support
- Panoramic power moonroof
- Rear parking camera
- quattro all-wheel drive system

The A7's refined interior welcomes you with genuine wood accents throughout the dashboard, console, and door panels. The dual-zone automatic climate control maintains your comfort, while the leather steering wheel and shift knob deliver a premium feel with every interaction. Navigation Plus keeps you on course, and the Bose audio system ensures your favorite content sounds exceptional during every drive.

This sedan's performance capabilities match its elegant appearance. The turbocharged V6 engine delivers 333 horsepower, while the sport suspension and quattro all-wheel drive provide responsive handling and confident traction in various conditions. The eight-speed automatic transmission with Tiptronic offers smooth acceleration and the ability to take manual control when desired.

Safety and convenience features are comprehensively integrated into this vehicle. Electronic stability control, traction control, and four-wheel independent suspension work together to maintain stability. Memory seating saves your preferred driving position, while remote keyless entry and the HomeLink garage door transmitter simplify daily routines. The auto-dimming rear-view mirror and rain-sensing wipers enhance visibility and awareness.

The exterior presents a polished appearance with its Moonlight Blue Metallic finish, S Line sport styling, and alloy wheels. LED interior lighting creates an upscale ambiance, while the power liftgate makes loading and unloading convenient.

This A7 represents a vehicle that balances luxury, technology, and driving dynamics for those who appreciate fine automobiles. Contact us today to schedule your time behind the wheel.

An overhead console, illuminated entry, and remote keyless entry round out the convenience features that make ownership hassle-free.

description:
The 2017 Volkswagen Golf R 4Motion is a compact hatchback with an emphasis on balanced performance and everyday usability. It uses Volkswagen's all-wheel-drive system and carries the Golf's familiar five-door body shape, which gives it a practical amount of space without changing the car's compact footprint. The exterior design is restrained and functional, with clean body lines, a low stance, and the familiar proportions of the Golf family. Details such as the R badging and discrete exterior trim separate it from more common versions of the model, while the overall shape remains easy to place in traffic and simple to park. The hatch opening adds versatility for cargo loading, and the rear seats provide added flexibility when the available space needs to be expanded.

Inside, the cabin follows the same straightforward approach. Leather seats are included, giving the interior a more finished appearance without introducing unnecessary complexity. The seating position is low and car-like, with controls placed within easy reach of the driver. Materials are arranged in a way that suits a compact performance model, and the interior design keeps attention on the main driving functions rather than decorative elements. The five-door body allows better access to the rear seating area, which makes the vehicle more convenient for passengers than a traditional two-door performance car. Storage areas are laid out in the expected places, and the rear cargo area remains useful for daily items, travel bags, or other standard loads that fit within a hatchback.

The vehicle includes Adaptive Cruise Control, Collision Warning, Navigation, and Apple CarPlay. Those systems add to the list of factory equipment without changing the car's basic character. The audio system is upgraded with Premium Audio, which places the sound equipment above the most basic factory setup. The technology package is integrated into the dash in a conventional manner, with the display and controls arranged for regular use rather than visual drama. The menu structure and interface reflect Volkswagen's typical layout for this model year, with functions grouped logically and operated through familiar in-car controls. The combination of these features gives the driver access to common convenience and information functions, while remaining consistent with the vehicle's practical interior design.

On the road, the Golf R 4Motion is defined by the way its mechanical package supports everyday driving and more demanding conditions without requiring special treatment from the person behind the wheel. The all-wheel-drive system contributes to the car's ability to put power down through changing surfaces, and the chassis tuning follows the same measured approach seen throughout the model. Steering, braking, and suspension behavior are set up for a compact performance hatchback rather than a large sedan or crossover, so the vehicle remains compact and responsive in normal use. Its size makes it manageable in city driving, while the drivetrain and hardware provide the kind of capability expected from this version of the Golf. The result is a car that keeps its functions clear, its controls familiar, and its equipment list focused on items that are directly useful in regular ownership.

Known for its legendary go-kart-like handling, distinctive personality, and upscale interior, the Cooper S offers a unique driving experience that stands out from ordinary compact cars. Whether navigating city streets or enjoying a winding back road, the MINI Cooper S combines excitement, efficiency, and everyday practicality in one stylish package.

Powered by a turbocharged 2.0 liter TwinPower Turbo four-cylinder engine producing 189 horsepower and 207 lb-ft of torque, the Cooper S delivers lively acceleration, quick throttle response, and impressive fuel efficiency. Paired with a responsive seven-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission or an available six-speed manual transmission, the powertrain provides smooth, precise shifts and engaging performance. The sport-tuned suspension and precise steering create the signature go-kart handling that has made MINI famous around the world.

The exterior styling of the 2020 MINI Cooper S is unmistakable and full of character. Featuring MINI's signature oval headlights, distinctive hexagonal grille with Cooper S badging, aggressive front bumper, dual center-mounted exhaust outlets, LED lighting, sporty alloy wheels, and a floating roof design, the Cooper S delivers a timeless appearance with modern performance-inspired details.

Inside the cabin, the Cooper S offers a premium and driver-focused interior with high-quality materials and creative design. Sport seats, a leather-wrapped multifunction steering wheel, ambient interior lighting, dual-zone automatic climate control, premium trim accents, and the iconic circular center display create a fun and upscale atmosphere. Despite its compact footprint, the hatchback design provides surprising cargo flexibility with split-folding rear seats for additional storage.

Technology is one of the Cooper S's strongest highlights. Equipped with a 6.5-inch or available 8.8-inch touchscreen infotainment system, Apple CarPlay compatibility, Bluetooth connectivity, USB ports, voice recognition, navigation availability, SiriusXM capability, wireless charging availability, and a premium Harman Kardon audio system, the Cooper S keeps drivers connected and entertained wherever the road leads.

Performance is where the Cooper S truly shines. The turbocharged engine, sport suspension, low center of gravity, and quick steering provide exceptional agility and confidence through corners. Selectable driving modes allow drivers to choose between efficient cruising and more spirited performance, making the Cooper S equally enjoyable for daily commuting and weekend drives.

Safety features include a rearview camera, rear parking sensors, Dynamic Stability Control, Dynamic Traction Control, Anti-Lock Braking System, Brake Assist, multiple airbags, tire pressure monitoring, and available driver-assistance technologies such as Forward Collision Warning, Automatic Emergency Braking, Adaptive Cruise Control, and Parking Assistant.

Owners consistently praise the 2020 MINI Cooper S for its turbocharged performance, agile handling, premium interior, unique styling, and enjoyable driving dynamics. Its combination of luxury, personality, efficiency, and versatility makes it one of the most distinctive premium compact cars available.

The 2020 MINI Cooper S is the perfect vehicle for someone looking for sporty performance, premium comfort, advanced technology, and unmistakable style in one complete package. Fun to drive, efficient, refined, and full of character, this MINI Cooper S is ready for its next owner and will continue delivering excitement and driving enjoyment for years to come.

With its efficient electric motor and reliable charging times, the Prius Prime offers an environmentally friendly driving experience without sacrificing utility.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Predictive brake assist - Be prepared for your big brake. Predictive brake assist monitors the available distance in front of you compared to your vehicles speed. If your speed exceeds the required distance to stop short of a collision, it readies your brakes to apply maximum stopping force when you use them. Predictive brake assist helps see to it that you stop.
